t: This is the Guardian Angels Roman Catholic Church, at 377 Mile End Road in Mile End. It was designed by Frederick Arthur Walters, a Scottish architect of the Victorian and Edwardian eras who was notable for his Roman Catholic churches. The church opened in 1903. It was paid for by Henry Fitzalan-Howard, the fifteenth Duke of Norfolk, as a memorial to his youngest sister, Lady Margaret Howard, who had done charitable work in the East End. So this is a building raised in memory of someone who helped local people.
